title: Managed Backup: billing correction
content:
For Managed Backup, the billing correction basis governs credit posting, upward adjustment.

## Policy clauses

For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review pretax amount plus tax amount, following tax rules.

Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison.

Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction.

An upward correction carries positive amount.

Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved.

No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction.

Link original source reference to the original charge and linked evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines.

Use cumulative gross correction amount from source-specific correction and service-credit totals for the correction comparison; cumulative pretax service-credit amount never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Authoritative evidence

Before credit posting, upward adjustment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference, Status, Decision. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the fixed handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge reference, report cumulative gross correction amount as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and cumulative pretax service-credit amount as absolute pretax amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in cumulative gross correction amount, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

The approved corrected gross target is the sum of the approved corrected pretax amount and corrected tax amount.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical original gross charge is USD 100, prior gross correction credits total USD 20, and prior upward adjustments total USD 5. Its corrected comparison amount is USD 85. An approved target of USD 70 requires a further credit of USD 15. A separate service-credit concession does not change this calculation. If the approved target were USD 85, no new adjustment would be made.
